description: Lists metadata of an authenticated user's saved calculations by calculator type. Use so an agent can help a user find a previously saved scenario before loading it. Never returns encrypted contents.

calculationType.description: Omit to list saved calculations across every calculator type.
calculationType.title: Calculator type

calculationTypes.description: Filter by several calculator types at once. Takes precedence over calculationType.
calculationTypes.title: Calculator types filter

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, compound <updatedAt>|<id> with an id tie-break so rows sharing updatedAt never skip. Preferred over offset for stable paging (sort: recent only).
cursor.title: Cursor

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use with limit for page-number paging.
offset.title: Offset

sort.description: recent = most recently updated first (default), oldest = least recently updated, created_desc/created_asc by creation date, name_asc/name_desc alphabetical. Cursor paging only applies to 'recent'.
sort.title: Sort order

name: list_saved_calculations
